feeds.title: Signing Time Blog
feeds.description: Baby Sign Language DVD and tutorials with Baby signing videos and lessons for signing with babies toddlers and children. Baby sign language can unlock the world around them and give their minds a head start. It lets babies communicate their needs rather than crying.

feeds.title: Baby Sign Language
feeds.description: BabySignLanguage.com is a project for parents teaching infants and toddlers early communication skills. We believe that early communication sets the foundation for accelerated learning, reduced frustration, and a closer relationship between parent and child. Our website contains baby sign language resources designed around the pedagogical needs of infants and toddlers.

feeds.title: My Smart Hands
feeds.description: My Smart Hands is an international company of amazing baby sign language instructors. We are all passionate about what we do and that passion is clear in our classes. We use 100% ASL signs, play entertaining games and learn a fun song in our classes!

feeds.title: CanDo Kiddo + Family
feeds.description: Your source for expert advice from a pediatric Occupational Therapist, a fellow parent, and child development nerd. Blogging, writing and sharing about baby and toddler play, developmental milestones, baby gear, baby and parent wellness, and intentional parenting.

feeds.title: MyDeafChild.org Blog
feeds.description: Learning just a few simple signs will help you start to communicate and connect with your child!

feeds.title: Signing Babies Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to help families learn how to communicate more effectively with their babies and toddlers using basic American Sign Language vocabulary, through live classes and online resources.

feeds.title: Tiny Signs Blog
feeds.description: Baby sign language printables, videos and classes for parents and teachers to teach infants, toddlers & preschoolers basic American Sign Language.

feeds.title: My Baby Fingers Blog
feeds.description: Baby Fingers aims to bring together music and sign language to aid in early language development and to strengthen relationships among family members and peers, within and outside of the Deaf community.
